text:
zoe: spotted plaintext partner SA key in staging backup: gs://redwood-logs/staging/backups/2026-03-20/ingest.log — snippet: `token=ya29.XXXX serviceAccount:partner-ingest-sa@partner-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com` :warning:
matt: ok can you paste the exact object and 3 surrounding lines?
zoe: path above. sample lines:
2026-03-20T01:12:03Z INFO request user=svc:partner-ingest-sa token=ya29.XXXX path=/v1/backup
2026-03-20T01:12:04Z INFO request user=svc:partner-ingest-sa path=/v1/backup/status
2026-03-20T01:12:05Z INFO backup complete
lina: starting containment checklist: 1) disable SA key, 2) revoke tokens, 3) KMS rewrap backups, 4) schedule Vault transit rotation.
tia: For Vault+KMS we should prefer KEK rewrap first, avoids mass transit re-encrypt. Proposed quick plan pinned in ticket.
jordan: oncall, need temp iam.admin for lina+zoe to revoke keys and manage KMS.
oncall: granted temporary iam.admin to lina and zoe until 2026-03-21T03:00Z. created SEC-2026-801.
ops-bot: ticket SEC-2026-801 created. scheduled rewrap job id=rw-4001 targets=gs://redwood-logs/staging/backups/2026-03-20/*.cipher
lina: disabling key: `gcloud iam service-accounts keys disable 0f1a2b3c --iam-account=partner-ingest-sa@partner-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com`
matt: also scan CI runners, GitHub Actions, and Dataflow templates for tokens issued from this SA.
tia: rewrap steps: create new KEK version, then run rewrap tool to re-encrypt objects to new KEK. sample commands posted in playbook.
zoe: found two more copies in staging-app-uploads/2026-03-19/*.log and one in artifacts/docker-layer-345.tar.gz
jordan: partner notified in p-partner-ingest channel. asked them to rotate their side keys and confirm.
lina: rewrap job started: rw-4001 processing 104 objects, concurrency 8. will report progress.
ops-bot: rw-4001 update: 8/104 complete, no errors. logs -> https://console.cloud.google.com/storage/browser/redwood-ops-logs/rw-4001/
matt: added post-incident tasks: add detection rule for `token=` patterns in backup objects and a DLP check on uploads to block tokens.
tia: I'll own Vault transit rotation after KMS rewrap. proposing maintenance 2026-03-22 03:00-04:00 UTC.
lina: revoke confirmed; rewrap job completed: 104/104, ran validation decrypts on sample files.
zoe: partner confirmed they've rotated their SA key. closing incident once transit rotation completes. thanks :white_check_mark:
